work: Toussaint 2003 PhD thesis, string-rule system (HC-T01 SPECIMEN, AS EXECUTED 2026-09-03)
tier: LEXIS_VERIFIED_PRIMARY (HC_T01_RESULTS.jsonl + execution packet, this repo)
note: HC-T01 AS RUN, not as proposed. A/B/C/E are genuinely satisfied: 2000-sample offspring probe with the real operator, same frozen probe across arms, 30 paired runs, paired permutation with Holm. But C_OPERATOR_CLEAN is NO because beta=0 populations cannot construct second-type operators AT ALL, so the ablated arm lacks the machinery class rather than having a reorganised version of it. F_MECHANICAL_NULL is only PARTIAL because the preregistered generation-zero null measured EXACTLY 0.00000 (VACUOUS) and had to be replaced mid-flight by a contemporaneous frozen probe. D_WITHIN_RUN is NO: X6-T2 NOT ATTEMPTED, X6-T3 NOT ESTABLISHED, and K7 FIRED.
verdict: RAN. Verdict HC_T01_WEAK_SIGNAL_ONLY after operator adjudication.

work: Parter, Kashtan & Alon 2008, Facilitated variation (PLoS CB 4:e1000206) + Text S1
domain: Boolean logic circuits + RNA, modularly varying goals
tier: LEXIS_VERIFIED_PRIMARY (Text S1 fetched and hashed independently in the Ergon pass; hash matches the Elenchus copy byte for byte); longitudinality ADJUDICATED 2026-09-04 by Elenchus from the retrieved bytes
note: Text S1 section 7 is titled 'Complete characterization of the phenotypic neighborhood'. Neutrality = 'the fraction of 1-mutant circuits that compute the same Boolean function as the wild-type (G1)'; the genome is 104 bits so the neighbourhood is ENUMERATED. Reported in ALL THREE arms FG/MVG/NBVG as mean +- SE over 30 simulations. The arms are GOAL SCHEDULES, so C_MECHANISM is NO. Longitudinality remains DISPUTED: Elenchus reads it as longitudinal and scores D4-weak; the sentences I read say 'genomes from the end of the last G1-epoch population were analyzed', which is endpoint-per-arm. UNRESOLVED. LONGITUDINALITY RESOLVED 2026-09-04, AND BOTH READINGS WERE RIGHT ABOUT DIFFERENT FIGURES. Figure 9C is genuinely longitudinal: 'Facilitated variation measure (mean+-SE) AS A FUNCTION OF GENERATIONS', 500 best-fitness circuits per population, 30-40 runs, with SE; likewise 9D, 7B and 4B. But the NEIGHBOURHOOD CONTENT measures I quoted are endpoint, and so is the ENTIRE NBVG comparison (Figs 3B/C, S3, S4, S7, S9, S13, section 5.1); the supplement states the rule outright: 'In MVG, analysis provided in main text was preformed on end-of-G1-epoch populations.' So Parter 2008 has a longitudinal measure of HOW MUCH and an endpoint measure of WHAT, and never both at once. Nobody in this lineage has a trajectory of neighbourhood CONTENT.
verdict: Local + exhaustive + all-arms + SE, but goal-schedule intervention and endpoint-shaped.

work: Kounios, Clune, Kouvaris, Wagner, Pavlicev, Weinreich & Watson 2016, arXiv 1612.05955
tier: LEXIS_VERIFIED_PRIMARY (arXiv PDF read in the Ergon pass)
note: One-to-one G-P map vs evolving GRN, mutation operator on G identical in both arms; 30 replicates, min/max bands, Mann-Whitney U. Its accessibility quantity is the DEVELOPMENTAL BASIN OF ATTRACTION, 'the number of G vectors that map into the concentric squares phenotype' - a pre-image size over the whole G-space, hence A_LOCAL NO. That basin measure is tracked in ONE unablated condition (Fig 8), not inside the arms; in the arms the longitudinal quantity IS the outcome. Shares HC-T01's machinery-presence confound (the one-to-one arm has no map to reorganise) rather than curing it.
verdict: Mechanism ablation with real statistics, but global detector, outside the arms.

work: Kouvaris, Clune, Kounios, Brede & Watson 2017, PLOS CB 13(4):e1005358
tier: LEXIS_VERIFIED_PRIMARY (article XML, S1, and author MATLAB read in the Ergon pass)
note: 5000 Sobol points uniform in [-1,1]^16 developed through the current B; the probe set is generated ONCE and reused at every epoch and in every arm, so A_SAME_PROBE is YES even though A_LOCAL is NO. All four arms are selection-side (K, kappa, L1, L2); both mutation functions are parameterless with hard-coded constants, so C_OPERATOR_CLEAN is YES trivially - the operator is never touched. Number of evolutionary replicates is NEVER STATED and the recovered GRN.m has no replicate loop. Censored outliers at the 2500-gen ceiling give D_UNREACHABILITY YES.
verdict: Best-controlled intervention of the five, worst statistics, wrong detector locality.

work: Tiso 2024, Univ. Groningen PhD thesis ch.3, 'The evolution of mutational transformers'
tier: LEXIS_VERIFIED_PRIMARY (thesis PDF fetched and the three load-bearing quotes re-read in the Ergon pass)
note: 'produced by 1000 different mutations at each locus of the best-performing GRN at a certain time point'; 'Distributions of the phenotypic effects of mutations at four different time points during the simulation'. Arms are GRN architecture x transfer function with environment and selection held fixed - a genuine representational manipulation. THE DETECTOR IS NOT REPORTED FOR THE TRIVIAL '1' NETWORK, which is the negative-control arm and the arm where the effect is absent. The within-run link is descriptive prose over 'a representative simulation', n=1, with no t -> t+n statistic. Never published.
verdict: Closest single work to the target composition; fails the control arm and quantification.

work: Petak, et al. 2025, PNAS, 'The variability of evolvability'
domain: GRN / cellular-automaton rule targets, dynamic fitness landscapes
tier: LEXIS_VERIFIED_PRIMARY for the main text (Europe PMC XML); SI Appendix, publisher PDF, bioRxiv preprint, Zenodo record 17302371 and the GitHub tarball all recovered and hashed this pass by the delegated gap-closing lane
note: 'Offspring were generated with the same mutation operation used in the evolutionary runs' (Fig 3A) - the only work in this set that is unambiguously A_REAL_OPERATOR. Longitudinal for ONE quantity, the percentage of offspring fitter than the parent, tracked 'after each environmental change over time' (Fig 4C), ~33 season boundaries over 9,899 generations in the released code. 15 replicates, 95% CIs. CORRECTED THIS PASS - C_MECHANISM IS NOT SIMPLY NO. Supplementary Figure 5 reports a genuine VARIATION-REGIME arm: 'runs where the individuals were randomly mutated', implemented in Methods as 'Every 300 generations every individual was mutated at every connection in the GRN by a value randomly drawn from a normal distribution (N(0,1)) in addition to the regular mutation step that was still applied every generation' (the mut_blast flag in main_model_script.py). BUT the detector is NOT run inside that arm: Supp Fig 5 reports fitness over time only, and the two offspring-distribution measurements are defined relative to an environmental change and have no counterpart in the mutation arm. The genotype-phenotype MAP is fixed in every arm (Supp Table 1 gives single values throughout), and the authors flag varying the SELECTION operator as future work. So the mechanism arm and the detector exist in the same paper and are never run together.
verdict: Published state of the art for a local longitudinal detector, AND it has a variation-regime arm - but the two never intersect.

work: Wagner A 2023, 'Evolvability-enhancing mutations...', Nature Communications 14:3624
domain: combinatorially complete empirical fitness landscapes (ParD3 protein; RNA)
tier: LEXIS_VERIFIED_PRIMARY (paper PDF and GitHub repo fetched and hashed THIS PASS)
note: THE MOST IMPORTANT WORK IN THIS SCORECARD FOR THE K7 PROBLEM. It is the only work found anywhere that SUBTRACTS THE CURRENT-STATE CONTRIBUTION BY CONSTRUCTION. Eq.1: for a NEUTRAL mutation (dw=0) to be evolvability-enhancing it requires mean fitness of m's neighbours minus mean fitness of wt's neighbours > 0. Eq.3 shows this is equivalent to positive epistasis. Hence F_COUPLING is NO - uniquely in this table. Acquisition is 10,000 simulated adaptive walks per landscape, so B/D_WITHIN_RUN are NO: it is a static landscape, not an evolving population.
verdict: Solves the conditioning problem HC-T01's K7 failed; not longitudinal, not an ablation.

work: Draghi, Parsons, Wagner & Plotkin 2010 (Nature) Supplementary Information s.6.1 / 6.2
tier: LANE_VERIFIED (HC-R01 read the SI verbatim; I did not re-verify this pass)
note: SI 6.2 is a genuine accessibility-at-t / acquisition-at-t+n design on evolving populations. It CANNOT answer the conditioning question by construction: 'the mutation rate to high-fitness types declined monotonically with q ... and so we used a linear regression of this relationship in our analytic predictions' - accessibility is MODELLED AS A FUNCTION OF robustness, so the two are collinear by design. Also 'each replicate begins from a potentially unique genotype', so founder PHENOTYPE is not matched. HC-R01 corrected its own earlier reading of this and the correction is recorded.
verdict: The only within-run t -> t+n accessibility design found; collinear by design.

work: Cowperthwaite, Economo, Harcombe, Miller & Meyers 2008, 'The ascent of the abundant'
domain: RNA, exhaustive folding of all sequences length 12-18
tier: LEXIS_VERIFIED_PRIMARY (publisher PDF fetched and Fig 6 read THIS PASS)
note: THE STRONGEST IMPORTED NEGATIVE. Across 2,400 forward simulations, TARGET phenotype abundance predicted arrival (r=0.76, P=2.2e-4) but FOUNDING phenotype abundance predicted nothing (r=-0.023, P=0.17). This is an independent, published analogue of HC-T01's own K7 kill, in a different substrate, seventeen years earlier. VERIFIED BY LEXIS: 2,400 simulations, 200 isogenic founding populations, 1e6 generations. CRITICAL NUANCE: it is the DESTINATION's accessibility that predicts, not the ORIGIN's. HC-T01 measures origin-side.
verdict: Published negative: starting accessibility did not predict acquisition.

work: Ancel & Fontana 2000, 'Plasticity, evolvability, and modularity in RNA'
tier: LANE_VERIFIED (HC-R01)
note: SIGN-INVERSION WARNING. Three sequence classes with an IDENTICAL minimum-free-energy structure differ in neutrality (0.184 random, 0.412 neutrally evolved, 0.456 canalised) by exhaustive one-error scan, and the class with the RICHEST history became an evolutionary DEAD END. More history bought LESS acquisition. Also a pure tautology case: the accessibility measure IS neutrality, i.e. robustness.
verdict: Matched-phenotype accessibility difference with the acquisition sign INVERTED.

work: Wagner A 2008, 'Robustness and evolvability: a paradox resolved' (Proc R Soc B 275:91)
tier: LANE_VERIFIED (HC-R01, PMC extraction)
note: Sequences from the SAME neutral network have largely non-overlapping novel-structure sets in their one-mutant neighbourhoods, median Q=0.6, from full 3n enumeration over 7.5e4 sequences of length 30. Acquisition NOT measured, and the cheap-state relation runs the WRONG WAY: genotype robustness vs evolvability Spearman s=-0.64, p<1e-17.
verdict: Large matched-state accessibility effect, never connected to acquisition.

work: Greenbury, Schaper, Ahnert & Louis 2016; Aguirre, Buldu, Stich & Manrubia 2011
domain: RNA, Polyomino, HP lattice protein GP maps
tier: LANE_VERIFIED (HC-R01)
note: The best-quantified matched-phenotype accessibility measurements in existence - 10,000 genotype triples per GP map, full 1-mutation neighbourhood enumerated, Bhattacharyya coefficient with mutual neighbours excluded - AND NO ACQUISITION ARM AT ALL. Comparing GP maps (RNA vs Polyomino vs HP) is a representation comparison but not an ablation within one evolving system. EFFECT-SIZE WARNING for any transfer: ratio 1.357 in RNA but 1.063 Polyomino and 1.025 HP lattice protein.
verdict: Measuring the effect is demonstrably not the bottleneck; connecting it is.

work: Misevic, Ofria & Lenski 2006, 'Sexual reproduction reshapes the genetic architecture of digital organisms', Proc R Soc B 273:457-464
tier: LANE_VERIFIED_PRIMARY (delegated EC/ALife lane; PDF or PMC full text on disk, load-bearing cells quoted verbatim)
note: THE CLOSEST HISTORICAL PRECEDENT FOR HC-T01 THAT EXISTS, AND NEITHER HERAKLES NOR THE ERGON PASS HAD IT. A CLEAN OPERATOR ON/OFF: 'Reproductive mode is determined by whether the divide-sex or divide-asex instruction is included in the instruction set. All genomes used the default set of 25 instructions plus one of these divide instructions.' LOCAL AND EXHAUSTIVE DETECTOR: 'We obtained an organism's genotype-phenotype (GP) map by separately mutating each site in its genome and recording any resulting changes in the computational traits performed by the mutants.' LONGITUDINAL: 'Over time, the genomes of sexual organisms became increasingly more physically modular than asexual ones (figure 3a)', with Fig 3a showing trajectories and 'Error bars are standard errors of the mean'. REPLICATION: '100 sexual and 100 asexual populations in identical environments'. F SATISFIED BY ORTHOGONALITY: the probe operator is point mutation, the ablated operator is recombination, and the probe is applied identically to both arms. MISSING D ENTIRELY - the accessibility-to-acquisition link appears only as an untested Discussion hypothesis: 'an indirect benefit to sex could arise from higher genomic modularity, which may increase their evolvability'.
verdict: 5/6. HC-T01's design, in Avida, in 2006, with the SAME missing cell HC-T01 failed to fill.

work: Kumawat, Lalejini, Acosta & Zaman 2024, 'Evolution takes multiple paths to evolvability', PNAS 121:e2413930121
domain: Avida digital evolution, six environment-change regimes
tier: LANE_VERIFIED_PRIMARY (delegated EC/ALife lane; PDF or PMC full text on disk, load-bearing cells quoted verbatim)
note: THE STRONGEST WORK IN THE ENTIRE SCORECARD, AND IT SUPPLIES THE CELL MISEVIC LACKS. EXHAUSTIVE LOCAL DETECTOR: 'We performed an exhaustive survey of the two-step mutational neighborhood of the dominant genotype ... we created every possible single- and double-point mutation.' LONGITUDINAL ALONG THE LINEAGE: 'We also isolated the lineages of the dominant genotypes and performed a similar mutational neighborhood analysis on the entire lineage', and Fig 4A records lineage mutants 'before and after' each environment switch. WITHIN-RUN PRECURSOR, IN THEIR OWN WORDS: 'mutational neighborhoods for Cyclic lineages appeared to anticipate the environment change; these lineages showed a high concentration of alternate mutants BEFORE the environment switched'. ACQUISITION OUTCOME THAT AVOIDS THE CEILING TRAP: 'lineage lag', the 'number of elapsed updates before dominant lineages were adapted to a changed environment' - a time-to-re-adapt measure, not gain toward a fixed optimum. F BY RECIPROCAL TRANSPLANT: 'To account for the direct effect of mutation rates, we also performed reciprocal experiments where the organisms that evolved in evolving mutation rates were assigned a mutation rate of 0.001, and the organisms that evolved under fixed mutation rates were assigned the mean mutation rate that evolved in the evolving mutation rate treatments.' E: 'Width of the ribbons is SE from 20 replicates', Mann-Whitney U and Kruskal-Wallis throughout. C IS ONLY PARTIAL: the primary knob is the environment-change regime; the operator-side manipulation is five FIXED MUTATION RATES and fixed-vs-evolving rate, i.e. a PARAMETER of the operator rather than an operator switched on or off.
verdict: 5/6. Missing only a clean operator on/off. Supplies exactly the D and F that Misevic lacks.

work: Rutten, Hogeweg & Beslon 2019, 'Adapting the engine to the fuel', BMC Evol Biol 19:191 (Aevol)
tier: LANE_VERIFIED_PRIMARY (delegated EC/ALife lane; PDF or PMC full text on disk, load-bearing cells quoted verbatim)
note: A_REAL_OPERATOR STATED AS EXPLICITLY AS ANYWHERE IN THE LITERATURE: 'given an individuals genotype, we used the same replication procedure as the one used during the evolutionary experiments (including the same mutation procedure) and produced large number offspring of this individual (2 million in the current experiment). We then measured the fitness distribution of these offspring.' LONGITUDINAL: 2 million offspring from the ancestor at generation 300,000 and 2 million at 390,000. TWO SEPARATE F CONTROLS: a NATIVE-MUTATOR arm that had the high rate from generation 0 ('the evolutionary dynamics of the mutator strains is not simply due to the mutational pressure. It is a specific response'), and an ENGINEERED-GENOME probe that reduces the non-essential compartment back to ancestral length to isolate the streamlining effect. C IS PARTIAL: a 100-fold point-mutation-RATE increase with all other rates held constant. D is qualitative only.
verdict: 5/6. Missing a clean operator on/off; D qualitative.

work: Tarapore & Mouret 2015, 'Evolvability signatures of generative encodings', Information Sciences 313:43-61
domain: evolutionary robotics, hexapod locomotion, five encodings
tier: LANE_VERIFIED_PRIMARY (delegated EC/ALife lane; PDF or PMC full text on disk, load-bearing cells quoted verbatim)
note: The cleanest offspring-cloud instrument in evolutionary robotics and a genuine five-way REPRESENTATION comparison, with a predictive link to damage recovery. It fails B on one sentence: 'The evolvability provided by the encoding schemes is analyzed by mutating the best individual of each replicate AT GENERATION 8,000 ... in 1,000 separate and independent instances.' One time point. F fails too: no generation-zero signature, and each arm probes with its own operator rather than a shared one.
verdict: 4/6. Endpoint-only detector; no mechanical-vs-evolved separation.

work: Reisinger & Miikkulainen 2006, 'Selecting for evolvable representations', GECCO 2006:1297-1304
tier: LANE_VERIFIED_PRIMARY (delegated EC/ALife lane; PDF or PMC full text on disk, load-bearing cells quoted verbatim)
note: NAMES CRITERION F TWENTY YEARS EARLY AND GIVES IT AN ESTIMATOR. 'in this paper the term latent evolvability will be used to describe the representation's underlying capacity for becoming evolvable, and acquired evolvability will be used to refer to its evolvability produced in evolution', operationalised as 'acquired evolvability can be measured directly as delta-L = L_final - E(L_0)'. That IS the mechanical-versus-evolved separation HC-T01 reinvented. It also states the tautology risk HC-T01 hit: 'if the control representation evolves high linkage values, then evolution may just be selecting for a higher mutation rate, rather than evolvability.' A fails: the detector is a genotypic strategy parameter, not an offspring cloud.
verdict: Supplies the VOCABULARY and the estimator for F. No offspring detector, no acquisition link.

work: Elena & Sanjuan 2008, 'Effect of genetic robustness on evolvability in digital organisms', BMC Evol Biol 8:284
tier: LANE_VERIFIED_PRIMARY (delegated EC/ALife lane; PDF or PMC full text on disk, load-bearing cells quoted verbatim)
note: The cleanest D found anywhere: 'Lineages were evolved for 5x10^4 updates and fitness values were collected every 500 updates. At each time point, a Spearman's correlation coefficient between robustness and evolvability was calculated using the 62 lineages as data points.' A repeated cross-run predictive statistic - exactly the shape HC-T01's K7 needed. But robustness is measured ONCE per ancestor, so B fails, and robustness is a cheap-state variable, so F_COUPLING is YES in the Ancel-and-Fontana sense.
verdict: Shows how to build the repeated cross-run predictive statistic; detector not longitudinal.

work: Hu, Banzhaf & Moore 2014, 'Evolutionary dynamics on multiple scales / Effects of recombination on phenotypic exploration', Artificial Life 20(4):457-470
tier: LANE_VERIFIED_PRIMARY (delegated EC/ALife lane; PDF or PMC full text on disk, load-bearing cells quoted verbatim)
note: A real recombination ON/OFF ablation ('Scenario 1 is driven solely by mutation, whereas scenario 2 is driven by both mutation and recombination') with an exhaustive one-mutant robustness detector and an orthogonal probe. B is only PARTIAL: 'Equilibrium robustness (epistasis) is calculated as the average genotypic robustness across all 100,000 generations' - a time AVERAGE plus an endpoint, not a trajectory. D is a cross-run correlation on the STARTING phenotype (R2=0.830, p=1.4e-6), so it is origin-side, which Cowperthwaite 2008 found predicts nothing.
verdict: Operator on/off + exhaustive local detector; detector time-averaged, D origin-side.
